title: Map — Give me list of all design prototypes in html

messages.content:
Give me list of all design prototypes in html

(Answering inside the brain-map view: mention the exact repo-relative paths of every relevant file so the map can highlight them.)

Here are the HTML design prototypes in the repo (excluding `.claude/worktrees/` clones and the CRS Brain app's own UI files like `crs-brain/public/*`):

**Demos / interactive prototypes** — `demos/`
- `demos/CRS_Canvas.html` — main UI canvas prototype
- `demos/CRS_Coming_Soon.html` — `#GR - Coming Soon` placeholder screen
- `demos/CRS_BreakList.html` — Break List module prototype
- `demos/casino_property_settings.html` — property settings screen
- `demos/casino_property_settings (2).html` — variant/copy of the above

**Design system** — `design/`
- `design/CRS_UI_Kit.html` — the UI kit / component reference

**Specs / blueprint** — `specs/`
- `specs/CRS_Blueprint.html` — generated blueprint spec (roadmap table)
- `specs/CRS_Blueprint_Source.html` — source variant
- `specs/Blueprint_Clear_Picture.html` — "clear picture" overview spec

**Brain-generated docs** — `crs-brain/data/docs/`
- `crs-brain/data/docs/buttons.html` — button component demo

Excluded as non-prototypes: `crs-brain/public/index.html` and `crs-brain/public/map.html` (the CRS Brain app shell itself), and every path under `.claude/worktrees/charming-allen-8a0e18/` (duplicate working-tree copies).

Want me to open or screenshot any of these, or spin up a new prototype under `crs-brain/data/docs/`?
I want to test how chat works it shall show thinking time etc

This message is the test. The chat already implements thinking-time display end to end — no changes needed:

- **Server** (`crs-brain/server.js:308-383`) runs `claude -p` in `stream-json` mode and emits SSE events: `block` (a work-block boundary, kind `thinking` or `tool`), `think` (extended-thinking text deltas), then `delta` (the answer).
- **Frontend** (`crs-brain/public/index.html:634-729`) renders each block as a collapsible "Thinking" card with a live timer that ticks every 500ms (`crs-brain/public/index.html:653`) and freezes the elapsed time when the block finishes (`finalizeCard`, line 655).

What you should be seeing right above this answer:
- A **"Thinking"** card with a stopwatch (e.g. `4s`) on the right — blue/pulsing while running, greyed when done.
- Click it to expand my reasoning text (the `.wbody`).
- Tool steps show as **"Reading"** (Read/Grep/Glob/Fetch) or **"Building"** (Edit/Write) cards, each with their own timer — you saw those fire when I read the two files just now.

If the Thinking card is **not** appearing, the likely cause is the model not emitting extended-thinking deltas — that's driven by the `effort` setting sent from the model/effort selectors (`index.html:701`) and passed as `--effort` (`server.js:324`). Higher effort → more visible thinking.

Want me to force a longer think so you get a clearly visible multi-second timer, or is the block showing correctly?
